notes.title: ALTF42 is now available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004887/a5f84bb19a44ed81e3eeff81710ee6a72b60d05a.png[/img]

Remodeling of existing stages, a wacky final stage, strange creatures and new items!
The final chapter of the knight and the chicken begins.

ALTF42 has officially launched.
We're also launching a speedrun challenge with a $5,000 prize pool.

You can be the best knight ever!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2187230/ALTF42/

notes.title: 6.03 Patch Note
notes.content:
1. I judged that the loop is somewhat difficult to obtain a lion's achievement, and made additional loop.

2. Add some decorations for the lightning area.You are receiving additional damage.Please leave comments. 

3. SAVE wind line.It's a decorative.

PS. The existing cleaning record system is thinking about direction, and it seems to be a little late.


Thank you.Please ask you a lot of comments.

notes.title: I Dont Fall Update Project
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004887/7c83afc1dc127fa587b86bbf66e4f742ed04afe7.png[/img]

hello.  This is the update history of I Dont Fall.

1. corrected wing system notation
2. added a path to the ending, a difficult course.

I will continue to work on the small patches we announced.
Thank you.

notes.title: UPDATE notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004887/d23c2d67bb680511b0156af675cb04393d4fe8f6.png[/img]

hello. I'm Kim Sangwon, the developer.
Thank you for playing the game as soon as it was released. 
I didn't add wasabi to make sushi.
I am planning several patches.

1. change the flapping system
2. added traps, securing the way to the ending
3. print clear time history
4. lots of other fun stuff 

ALTF4 didn't have SAVE balloons, corpse spawns, etc. in the beginning.
We will continue to make the game better with many patches.

We will continue to work on small patches.
Another small update is planned for tonight.
Thank you.

And if you have any funny suggestions, please leave them in the comments. We'll take them into consideration.

P.S. Part 2 of ALTF4 is officially coming out next week, and while it's probably spicier, we'll make sure IDONTFALL is a reward for your support.
We'll also be updating the 11th floor. 
... Thank you. It's hard being a lone developer, but I'm glad you like it, so I'll keep up the good work.

notes.title: I DONT FALL is now available.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004887/d20e94252887eee64be2aae4287c098075d072bb.png[/img]


<I Dont Fall> has been released.
The heroes Pegasus and Bellerophon dream of being more than heroes, they dream of being gods. You can fly through the sky and become a god! You just have to make sure you don't fall down.

Thank you so much for your patience. I hope you have a great time playing.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004887/2289bf59473d7fbdc9831375a4b4eb9353d1a96c.png[/img]

notes.title: I Dont Fall Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004887/a3fe43c986f53365d76fcd13193482c10bc8aa79.png[/img]

hello. I'm Kim Sangwon, the developer.
The game was originally scheduled to be released on the 24th, but due to optimization issues, we've changed it to the 27th.
I apologize to everyone for the delay.
I will do my best to make sure you have the best experience possible.

I wish you all the best.



++WISHLIST Event

Add 'I Dont Fall' to your wishlist, leave a comment and we'll give you a free key to the horror adventure 'Roll me Home' from our games.
The event will last until the 26th, the day before the release of 'I Dont Fall'.
